empty-shop.alt: Leo Mabuku in the empty shop, with bare shelves and a garment rack
empty-shop.caption: 31 August 2022 — inside the store I had found, before stock and displays filled the space.

assembly.alt: Open cartons, tools and furniture parts on the shop floor
assembly.caption: Opening the boxes: unpacking furniture and preparing the shop floor as the range expanded.

clothing.alt: Clothes, curtains, baskets and household goods displayed in the shop
clothing.caption: Clothing and household goods formed part of a range that grew beyond bedding.

mixed-display.alt: Cabinets, glass furniture, rugs and hanging clothes inside the store
mixed-display.caption: The range evolved: furniture, clothing and textiles shared the shop floor.

shop-sign.alt: A white cabinet outside beneath the Leo M Suppliers Shop No. 3 sign
shop-sign.caption: A name on the window, a place in Livingstone: Leo M. Suppliers, Shop No. 3.

stocked-store.alt: Wide view of the stocked shop with furniture, bedding and household goods
stocked-store.caption: Behind a stocked shop were ordering decisions, product displays and everyday responsibility.

owner.alt: Leo Mabuku in a pale-blue shirt and tie inside the furniture shop
owner.caption: My work stretched across sales, customers, employees and the day-to-day running of the shop.

dining-set.alt: Glass dining table and six chairs displayed inside the shop
dining-set.caption: Furniture became a new part of the business, bringing practical assembly and display work.

store-aisle.alt: A stocked aisle with cabinets, baby walkers, fans and boxed goods
store-aisle.caption: Another view of the shop’s mix of furniture and household products.

television-display.alt: Television, cabinets and glass furniture arranged inside the shop
television-display.caption: Arranging products so customers could see the range together.

mirror-portrait.alt: A mirror self-portrait inside the shop, with clothing and stock behind
mirror-portrait.caption: A personal photograph from inside the shop during its operating years.

three-stools.alt: Black, white and red pedestal stools outside the shop sign
three-stools.caption: Furniture displayed outside the shop, with the business sign behind it.

two-chairs.alt: Black and orange upholstered pedestal chairs inside the shop
two-chairs.caption: A closer look at the furniture range.

owner-wide.alt: Leo Mabuku standing among furniture inside the shop
owner-wide.caption: The shop as a workplace, as well as a space for displaying products.

entrance.alt: A portrait at the shop entrance beside a red stool
entrance.caption: At the entrance to the Livingstone shop.

personal-archive.alt: A close self-portrait with household stock visible behind
personal-archive.caption: A personal record from the shop’s operating years.

white-tv-unit.alt: White cabinet and black television mount outside the business sign
white-tv-unit.caption: A furniture display beside the shop’s historical sign.

black-tv-unit.alt: Black glass television stand outside the shop window
black-tv-unit.caption: Another example of the assembled furniture on display.

clothing-furniture.alt: Clothing, textiles, fans and glass furniture in the same shop
clothing-furniture.caption: The furniture range sat alongside clothing, bedding and household goods.
